---MVP1 Dynamics CI - Corporate

--DEMOGRAPHICS

SELECT
CustomerID
,CustomerName
,GlobalCIF
,EntityCIF
,FCBSCIF
,CustomerType
,DateOfIncorporation
,MaritalStatus
,Gender
,MobileNumber
,EmailAddress
,AddressLine1
,AddressLine2
,City
,Province
,ZipCode
,Country
,SMEClassification
,LineOfActivity
,IndustryDescription
,Subsector
,SubsectorDescription
,Tenure
,DataPrivacyConsent
,LastKYCDate
,RiskRatingType
,RiskRating
,SuspendedIndicator
,ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,RIBBOBEnrollmentIndicator                                                                                                                                                      
,PayrollIndicator
,GenerationalCohort
,MarketSegment                                                                                                                         
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate 
where CustomerID = 'C00000335'

---MEASURES
SELECT
CustomerID
,TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared
,TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Shared
,TotalCreditLimitLoans_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPCards
,TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,TotalCreditLimitCards
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Shared
,TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Shared
,TotalFundValueTrust_Shared
,TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Shared
,TotalRelationshipBalance_Full
,TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Full
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Full
,TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Full
,TotalCreditLimitLoans_Full
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Full
,TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Full
,TotalFundValueTrust_Full
,TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Full

FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate
where CustomerID = 'C00000335'


---ACTIVITIES
--CARDS--
SELECT
CustomerID, OpenedDate, ProductType, CreditLimit                                                                                                                           
FROM DW.CI_Cards_Corporate
where CustomerID = '';

--DEPOSITS--
SELECT
CustomerID, OpenedDate, ProductDetails, OutstandingBalance_Shared                                                                                                                          
FROM DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate
where CustomerID = '';

--check DEPOSIT accounts with Demographics Table
SELECT DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate.CustomerID, OpenedDate, ProductType, ProductDetails, OutstandingBalance_Shared 
FROM DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate
INNER JOIN DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate ON DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate.CustomerID = DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate.CustomerID
WHERE DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate.CustomerID = 'C00020946'
ORDER BY DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate.OpenedDate DESC


--LOANS--
SELECT
CustomerID, OpenedDate, ProductType, CreditLimit_Shared
FROM DW.CI_Loans_Corporate
where CustomerID = '';

--check LOANS accounts with Demographics Table
SELECT DW.CI_Loans_Corporate.CustomerID, OpenedDate, ProductType, ProductDetails, CreditLimit_Shared
FROM DW.CI_Loans_Corporate
INNER JOIN DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate ON DW.CI_Loans_Corporate.CustomerID = DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate.CustomerID
WHERE DW.CI_Loans_Corporate.CustomerID = 'C00020849'
ORDER BY DW.CI_Loans_Corporate.OpenedDate DESC

--SECURITIES--
SELECT
CustomerID, OpenedDate, Product_Type, PortfolioSize_Shared
FROM DW.CI_Securities_Corporate
where CustomerID = '';

--TREASURY--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, OutstandingInvestmentProrated
FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate
where CustomerID = 'C00000271';

SELECT DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate.CustomerID, OpenedDate, ProductType, ProductDetails, OutstandingInvestmentProrated
FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate
INNER JOIN Dw.CI_Demographics_Corporate ON DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate.CustomerID = DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate.CustomerID
where DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate.CustomerID IN ('C00000271','C00006638','C00008489');

SELECT DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate.CustomerID, OpenedDate, ProductType, ProductDetails, OutstandingInvestmentProrated
FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate
INNER JOIN Dw.CI_Demographics_Corporate ON DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate.CustomerID = DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate.CustomerID
where DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate.OutstandingInvestmentProrated > 0 AND DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate.OutstandingInvestmentProrated IS NOT NULL;

--TRUST--
SELECT
OpenedDate, Product_Type, AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared
FROM DW.CI_Trust_Corporate
where CustomerID = '';






--SEGMENTS
SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate 
where subsectordescription = 'TELECOMMUNICATIONS'

SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate 
where TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared > 10000000




--TOTAL RECORD COUNT

SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate
